title: Engineering Services for Mary Townes and BRITE Lab Systems Upgrades
short_description: Laboratory and building systems upgrades at North Carolina Central University in Durham.
project_scope: Upgrade of various laboratory and building systems at North Carolina Central University to support lab equipment upgrades. Scope includes cold room split system replacement, lab air compressor replacement, autoclave exhaust upgrade, snorkel removal, lab gas storage ventilation, electrical generator replacement, and RO/DI water replacement. services: Engineering and design services for building and laboratory system upgrades; requested disciplines include architecture services, interior design/space planning, landscape architecture, rehabilitation and refurbishment, civil engineering, and structural engineering.
relevance_explanation:
- Primarily a building systems and laboratory infrastructure upgrade project, not a structurally demanding building or bridge.
- Strong focus on MEP-type replacements such as compressors, exhaust, ventilation, generator, and water systems.
- Structural engineering is listed, but no significant structural scope or complex load-bearing structure is described.
- Limited fit with sbp's core strengths in bridges, long-span roofs, special structures, and architecturally demanding structural design.
fee_explanation: No explicit design fee is stated in the source. Only total construction cost of 2.0 million USD is provided.
references_qualifications: Requested disciplines include architecture, interior design/space planning, landscape architecture, rehabilitation and refurbishment, civil engineering, and structural engineering. No specific reference counts or qualification thresholds are stated in the source.
